title: HanaMesh AppHost install target
description: Public identifiers a caller may hand to the AppHost market. The market resolves its own catalog, shows its own confirmation and performs the install; callers never supply versions, download locations or confirmation. Lengths are JavaScript string lengths.

x-hanamesh-contract.name: hanamesh.install-target

loopback.scope: library HTTP routes and install-target navigation
loopback.host: Only exact alias:<configured parentOrigin port> Host headers are accepted; no extra Host, port or spelling. The configured parentOrigin remains the canonical 127.0.0.1 origin.
loopback.origin: When supplied, Origin must exactly match the request Host with the configured http scheme. The aliases are separate browser origins: cross-alias, cross-port, foreign and opaque origins are refused.
loopback.install: POST still requires exact request Origin, X-HanaMesh-Client: workspace-v1, non-iframe, host authentication and authorization; only explicit market confirmation installs.
loopback.authentication: Each alias uses its own normal DSH authentication; no cookie/token copying or authentication bypass.

x-hanamesh-contract.unversioned: An input without contractVersion keeps the v1 semantics shipped in 0.2.0-rc.7.
x-hanamesh-contract.mismatch: Any contractVersion other than a supported value is refused with CONTRACT_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED (HTTP 400, details.supported) before other field checks; nothing is resolved or installed.

contractVersion.description: Optional declaration of the contract version the caller speaks.

target.description: openInstallTarget input, GET /hanamesh/library/target query and #hanamesh-install? fragment fields. At least one identifier; both must name the same catalog item. Every other field is refused.

receipt.description: openInstallTarget resolution receipt; not an install result.

resolution.description: GET /hanamesh/library/target 200 body. contractVersion is the provider's declaration (added in 0.2.0-rc.8).

error.description: Refusal body of the HTTP routes; the client rejects with the same code.

providerDeclaration.description: package.json hanamesh.installTarget of a provider package.
